cause.what_happened: No news was found for 09-28 or 09-29. The fall is the third leg down (-35% from $2.12 on 09-22) since the 09-25 after-hours 8-K. That 8-K swapped the $12.00 Series C-1 notes into Series D notes convertible at the holder's option at any time at an alternate price of 93% of the lowest VWAP over the prior seven trading days, up to 19.99% of outstanding shares before stockholder approval. It also repriced the June warrants from $12.00 to $2.45. The shape (0.69x volume, 93% intraday, grinding) matches conversion selling rather than a news event. Whether conversions actually happened today is inferred, not observed.

findings.finding: Series D noteholders can convert at any time at 93% of the lowest 7-trading-day VWAP (up to about 1.8m shares, 19.99% of ~9.09m, before stockholder approval) and sell. Today's low VWAP enters that lookback, so tomorrow's conversions price below today's close. That is a continuing, reflexive seller in the 2026-09-30 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The conversion right has been live since 2026-09-25 with no leak-out cap found in the exchange agreement, so conversion shares can be delivered and sold in the 2026-09-30 session itself. The supply lands inside the window rather than at a later date.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the exchange 8-K (after hours 09-25), falls on 09-28 (-16.92%) and 09-29 (-17.07%) have come back to back. Of the name's own comparable falls in the toxic-note period, 09-15 went on to -11.22% the next session and 09-28 to -17.07%. Across all 27 comparable falls the median next close is 0.0%.
findings.why_not_priced: A close prices the shares already sold, not the ones a holder converts tomorrow at a guaranteed 7% below the running low. While that discount exists, the holder profits by converting and selling into any bid, so a bounce gets sold into. If the price already held this, you would expect a halt in the drift, or an 8-K showing the 19.99% cap is used up. Neither exists: no filing after 09-25 appears in EDGAR's submissions feed.
findings.independence: The 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1378140/000149315226042579/form10-q.htm) shows ~$8.1m of note carrying value against $7.36m of cash, going-concern doubt and an unusable ATM. So the notes are the company's only live source of equity supply, and nothing else would absorb it.
